description: Land Title Settlement Department - Etamurungagoda, Harispattuwa D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 4320315 (23/0949)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Land Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, owner names, land extents, and property details. The content is entirely focused on land ownership and title registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and land title settlements.
